title: Time checks with an injected clock
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time; HCERT Specification, 3.2.6 Issued At.

statements.label: Time checks with an injected clock
statements.requirement: The verifier SHALL reject a certificate whose exp is in the past. It SHALL flag an iat in the future, beyond a configurable clock-skew tolerance. Time SHALL come from an injected Clock. Extra iat-based policies (for example a maximum age) MAY be configured.

sources.quote: Decode the CBOR payload and check exp and iat against the current time.
after which a Verifier MUST reject the Payload as expired
